chunks: Never so, for there will be no escape.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'La Wazara' in Surah Al-Qiyamah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a definitive refutation of the materialist claim that death is an absolute end, emphasizing that the Creator who initiated existence can certainly restore it. The phrase 'no way out' (la wazara) underscores the inescapability of divine justice, serving as a spiritual warning to those who arrogantly dismiss the Hereafter. This concept reinforces the Shia belief in the continuity of the soul and the ultimate accountability of all beings before Allah.
